description: This file defines the Category model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, including methods to retrieve category details, subcategories, filters, and layout IDs from the database.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class for handling category data, including retrieval of category info, subcategories, filters, and layout IDs.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a specific category record from the database based on category ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories of a given parent category.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves filter groups and filters associated with a specific category.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID assigned to a specific category.
